hypothesis: Conditioned on the frozen data-free Clark-Hash residual gate passing, activation-weighted fitting followed by twelve hard-INT4 coefficient steps will reduce held-out Qwen3.8-27B sampled-row output error by at least 1% versus the exported data-free hash correction, without regressing the symmetric optimal group-128 ternary output baseline or exceeding 1.57 projected component bits per weight

scope.sampled_rows: the same frozen sixteen middle rows of each layer-0 gate, up, and down projection used by the parent hash-residual screen
scope.claim_boundary: sampled Qwen3.8-27B layer-output screen only; not a complete layer, model, capability, storage, runtime, semi-lossless, or breakthrough result

parents.candidate_selection: use exactly the parent gate's selected_candidate; no seed, dimension, support, tensor, or row reselection is permitted

activation_data.calibration_and_validation_texts: exactly the disjoint, pre-evaluation splits frozen by the activation-QAT preregistration
activation_data.gate_up_inputs: exact BF16 layer-0 prefix post-attention normalized states
activation_data.evaluation_data_exclusion: CUTE, MATH-500, code trace, MMLU, and WikiText items are forbidden from both activation splits
activation_data.validation_use: held-out validation activations are used only for the frozen promotion decision, never coefficient fitting or checkpoint selection

representation.formula: W approximately equals T plus A R
representation.ternary_matrix: reuse the deterministic parent candidate's fixed-support group-128 T with exported FP16 group scales
representation.projection: reuse the parent Clark Hash SplitMix64 sparse signed R with four hashes per input and no stored matrix
representation.coefficient_matrix: signed per-output-row INT4 levels -7 through 7 plus one FP16 scale
representation.runtime_algebra: T x plus A times R x
representation.gate_up_reuse: one R x sketch may be shared by the gate and up projections when their selected dimensions and projection seed agree

training.closed_form: solve calibration-output least squares for A with ridge centered on the parent data-free coefficients
training.hard_forward: signed per-row INT4 with an FP16 export scale and straight-through coefficient gradients
training.checkpoint_selection: retain the lowest calibration NMSE exported INT4 coefficient step, including closed-form step zero; validation is never used for selection

resources.persistent_output_bytes: less than 4 MiB excluding the separately authenticated shared activation cache

promotion_rules: a parent hash rejection produces a valid nonpromotion skip and does not launch activation fitting
a pass advances to complete layer-output materialization and native fused T plus A R kernel work only
a fail is a valid negative result for this frozen family and does not authorize seed, span, validation, or threshold tuning
CUTE MMLU-type MATH WikiText code and paired CPU throughput remain mandatory before any model-quality claim
complete-model scales retained tensors layout metadata and native runtime bytes remain separately required
infrastructure-invalid work is neither a zero nor a completed result
this sampled screen cannot establish a semi-lossless or scientific breakthrough claim
